name: io.github.xlbbb-cn/mcp-ssh-exec-cmd
title: SSH Host Storage & Remote Exec
description: Stdio MCP server for SSH host storage and remote command execution with a connection-pool monitor.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SSH_MASTER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 64-hex-character AES-256-GCM master key; auto-generated into <config dir>/master.key when unset.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SSH_POOL_IDLE_MS
environmentVariables.description: Idle SSH connections are closed after this many milliseconds (default: 60000, 0 disables pooling).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_SSH_POOL_MAX_HOSTS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum number of pooled SSH connections (default: 32).
